pages.text: A charger with four slots, one on each side (north, east, south and west), for items that hold energy. Right-click a side's slot to put an item in or take it out, or use the screen.$(br2)Energy goes in and out through the top and bottom. Each slot has a mode:$(li)$(l)Charge$(): fills the item.
$(li)$(l)Discharge$(): drains the item, out of the top and bottom and into charging slots.$(li)$(l)Buffer$(): both.$(li)$(l)Disabled$(): ignored.

pages.title: Automation
pages.text: $(l)Balanced mode$() splits incoming energy evenly between the charging slots instead of filling one at a time.$(br2)Pipes and hoppers can insert and remove items on each side. A charging item can be pulled out once full, and a discharging one once empty, which makes simple auto-charging lines easy. Redstone control is set in the screen.
